<p class="page-kicker">A work in progress, intentionally</p>
<p class="page-intro">I’m Ankit, a student in the UBC Master of Data Science program. I’m using this space to make sense of the work, questions, and experiences that shape my path through data.</p>

## Right now

I’m focused on building a strong foundation across the data science toolkit while staying close to the human questions underneath the technical ones. The most interesting problems rarely arrive in tidy columns.

## What I’m looking for

Good questions, generous collaborators, and projects where analysis can become something genuinely useful. I’m especially drawn to work that rewards both curiosity and care.

## Beyond the coursework

This site is also a practice in reflection: making room for the parts of learning that do not fit neatly into a résumé. Expect notes, experiments, and honest observations as the year unfolds.
